card.name: End of a number or unit
card.fires_on: The last digit of a number in a reference or lab value, or the unit word such as minute or mg right after a number. It is common in verse and journal citations and in rates or thresholds.

modes.label: Unit after a number
modes.description: The unit word that completes a rate or dose, such as minute after beats per or mg after a number.
modes.example: Waltz is danced twice as fast – around 180 beats per<< minute>>.

modes.label: Final digit in a citation
modes.description: The last digit of a volume, verse or section number in a scripture or journal reference.

modes.label: Digit in a lab threshold
modes.description: The last digit of a lab value or cutoff in a clinical statement.

card.plain: It fires on the final piece of a number or its unit, where the number is done and the next thing is punctuation or a new item.
